svg.title: AI-native engineering transformed manual eDiscovery into a scalable legal technology platform
svg.desc: Anonymous legal technology case study showing how a hybrid team of 120 engineers and AI agents automated discovery, review and redaction while improving cost, precision and defensibility.
svg.text: Hybrid human-and-agent teams automated high-volume legal work while preserving defensible control
Data sources and custodians took time to identify
Quality control limited throughput and scale
Productized discovery, review, redaction and case preparation
A 120-engineer organization combined specialist judgment with agents
AI processed high-volume work while specialists reviewed exceptions
The platform converted specialist effort into a scalable, defensible legal workflow
